states.description: User or agent requests presentation of a task result, deliverable, or summary.
invariants: Target and mode are parsed.
No viewer is assumed to exist.

states.description: Appropriate presentation mechanism is selected (explorer, viewer/editor, or HUD/launcher) and launch command is issued.
invariants: Pre-launch desktop windows are snapshotted.
Command is dispatched via secure process launcher.

states.description: Process handle or launch signal is confirmed.
invariants: Process PID is recorded if available.
Process start does NOT imply window visibility or target observation.

states.description: A window associated with the launched process or mechanism is discovered via Win32 EnumWindows on the interactive desktop.
invariants: Window HWND is non-null.
Window was not part of the pre-launch snapshot (or is positively identified).

states.description: The discovered window is verified to correspond to the requested target.
invariants: Process ID matches spawned process or mechanism (e.g., explorer.exe, notepad.exe, AstraRun.exe).
Window title or UI surface matches target file name, folder name, or result summary.
Unrelated pre-existing windows are rejected.

states.description: The target window is physically rendered and visible to the user.
invariants: IsWindow(hwnd) is True.
IsWindowVisible(hwnd) is True.
DwmGetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_CLOAKED) is 0 (not cloaked).
Window rect intersects the physical primary monitor.
Width and height are non-zero.

states.description: For document/text viewers, file title/path is bound. For HUD cards, summary text is bound.
invariants: Content corresponds to task deliverable.

states.description: Affirmative terminal state: the intended result was successfully and visibly presented to the user.
invariants: Cannot be reached from REQUESTED alone.
Cannot be reached from Popen success alone.
Cannot be reached from file existence on disk alone.
Requires verified_hwnd != null, target_observed == True, and positive identity match.

states.description: Fail-closed terminal state: presentation was requested/attempted, but target window was not physically observed or verified.
invariants: RESULT_PRESENTED event is strictly forbidden.
CapabilityResult returns success=False.
Error diagnostics explain the exact failure reason.

fail_closed_rules: WRONG_WINDOW_REJECTION: Window must belong to correct target process and title
